messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER — SEV: P1 — private-cluster-prod: gpu-pool-high-queue threshold exceeded (queue len 12,400). paging on-call.
Samir Patel: ack, I'm taking lead. collecting quick context. tagging infra.
Claire Huang: joining. looking at autoscaler and node provisioning timeline. kubectl shows pods Pending due to node selectors.
Mike O'Connor: on standby, will open warm-up mitigation if needed.
Elaine Park: looping in CS for customer impact notice. Which customer clusters are hitting this?
Josh Rivera: customer-reports: two large private VPC deployments (acme-retail & medsys-prod) show spike in inference job submissions at 08:14 UTC. both pinned to gpu-heavy pool.
Samir Patel: initial hypothesis: autoscaler failing to provision nodes fast enough; warmup/prepull step taking >6m due to large images and AWS limit on concurrent ENI attachments in AZ.
infra-bot: autoscaler-log: ERROR: scale-up rejected: capacity-constraints in us-west-2a (quota=0 for instance-type nvidia-a100-40gb). retry_cooldown=30s.
Claire Huang: grabbing autoscaler logs:
```
2026-03-15T08:15:12Z autoscaler controller: requested 4 nodes for pool gpu-heavy
2026-03-15T08:15:13Z cloud-provider: allocation failed: InsufficientInstanceCapacity: no nvidia-a100-40gb in us-west-2a
2026-03-15T08:15:13Z autoscaler controller: enqueue retry (backoff)
2026-03-15T08:18:44Z kubelet[acme-retail-node-1]: ImagePullBackOff: failed to pull redwood-runtime:v3.1.2
2026-03-15T08:20:02Z node-provisioner: instance created, but kubelet did not register within 4m
```
Samir Patel: that ImagePullBackOff + slow registration explains padding in warmup. With autoscaler stuck on capacity, queue grows.
Mike O'Connor: mitigation plan options:
- A) manual scale using smaller-instance GPUs available (e.g., vram-30gb) and use model-variant fallback
- B) free up existing pool by evicting non-critical jobs and preemptible workloads
- C) route new requests to hosted fallback (hosted-api) for affected customers for next 30m
Claire Huang: also seeing high image download concurrency causing S3 throttling in same region. pulling same 8GB runtime image concurrently -> slow.
Elaine Park: CS recommends option C + a customer-facing message: short degradation, queuing for async jobs, recommend retry. I can send an initial notice once we confirm ETA.
Samir Patel: executing manual mitigation: increasing gpu-spot pool with different SKU in us-west-2b and kicking off model-variant routing. command:
```
# scale the alternate pool and mark as warmup
redctl cluster scale --cluster private-prod-acme --pool gpu-alt --replicas 4 --instance-type gpu-vram-30
redctl routing update --cluster private-prod-acme --route gpu-heavy:fallback=gpu-alt-variant
```
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated for cluster private-prod-acme: scale job id=scale-8472, started 08:22:10Z
Mike O'Connor: spun up 4 alt nodes. starting pre-pull of runtime on those nodes to avoid image thrash.
```
# prepull on new nodes
kubectl -n redwood exec node-warmup -- /bin/sh -c 'docker pull registry.redwood.dev/runtime:v3.1.2 && docker pull registry.redwood.dev/models/small-a100:1.0'
```
Claire Huang: I'm watching the queue metrics: queue len dropping from 12.4k -> 7.1k since 08:28. latency tail improving but still elevated.
Josh Rivera: CS draft: "We're experiencing degraded throughput for private VPC inference in us-west-2. Our mitigation is in progress; jobs are being queued or routed to fallback nodes. Expected stabilization in ~30-45 minutes. We'll share updates at 15 and 45 minutes."
Elaine Park: sending to legal/ops for approval before sending to customers.
Samir Patel: root cause callouts so far: AZ-specific instance shortages + S3/image download contention + autoscaler backoff policy too aggressive for multi-AZ fallback.
Claire Huang: immediate action items:
- relax autoscaler AZ affinity and allow cross-AZ placement (Claire)
- add prewarm for large runtime image in scale path (Mike)
- implement transient routing to hosted fallback for critical customers (Samir/Eng-Platform)
- CS notification and customer-level mitigation (Elaine/Josh)
Mike O'Connor: implementing prewarm now. reduced image concurrency by adding randomized pull jitter in bootstrap. patch queued: "reduce-image-pull-concurrency".
infra-bot: metric update: private-cluster-prod.gpu_pool.queue_length 12.4k -> 3.8k over 22m, node-ready count +4.
Samir Patel: handoff note: Claire, can you own a short postmortem? assign to you for 72h. I'll keep monitoring until stabilization.
Claire Huang: got it. will collect logs, autoscaler config, and timeline. tagging this SEV in the tracker and will add mitigation timeline.
Elaine Park: customer notice queued, scheduled send at 08:45 after legal approval.
Josh Rivera: customer-impact: batch inference jobs for two customers delayed, interactive latency increased 3-5x for pinned deployments. No data leakage or correctness issues reported.
Samir Patel: closing the active pager once metrics show stable queue <1k and node registration complete. current plan: keep routing fallback for 1hr then roll back. ETA check at 08:45.
Mike O'Connor: final note: long-term fix suggestions: add cross-AZ provisioning fallback, autoscaler smarter backoff (differentiate instance shortage vs transient errors), and prewarm images on scale-up path.
Claire Huang: adding postmortem labels: cause=capacity-shortage,image-throttle,warmup-delay; impact=queued-jobs,latency-degradation; owner=Claire Huang
Samir Patel: thanks all — I'll update incident channel and escalate to platform eng for the autoscaler config follow-up.
deploy-bot: scale job id=scale-8472 completed at 08:40:12Z, new nodes registered=4.
infra-bot: final metric snapshot at 08:45: queue_length=820, avg_latency=420ms (pre-incident baseline 120ms).
Claire Huang: last action: start postmortem doc and schedule blameless review.
Mike O'Connor: thumbs up.
Elaine Park: sending customer messages now.
Samir Patel: closing pager — monitoring in background.
